mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rent_termination (order_id, tenant_id, apply_time, effective_end_period, deduct_amount, refund_amount, refund_status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{tenantId}, #{applyTime}, #{effectiveEndPeriod}, #{deductAmount}, #{refundAmount}, #{refundStatus}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rent_termination WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE rent_termination SET deduct_amount = #{deductAmount}, refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, refund_status = 1, refund_time = #{refundTime}, refund_txn_id = #{refundTxnId}, remark = #{remark} WHERE id = #{id} AND refund_status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rent_termination WHERE refund_status = 0 AND #{today} > DATE_ADD( LAST_DAY(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(effective_end_period, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d')), INTERVAL #{graceDays} DAY) ORDER BY id
